method: independent second check as a careful teacher; every item, sentence, explanation, gq and panel read; no numeric items; encyclopedia titles checked with tools/review.mjs wiki; give-away options reduced with tools/options.mjs

corrections.what: English 'The window is open' omitted 'şimdi'; now 'The window is open now.'
'Sen nasılsın bugün?' is unnatural word order; replaced by 'Bugün nasılsın Ali?'
Confusing question on Hoşça kal reworded (who is leaving); why expanded
English now matches Turkish ('This apple is red', 'The sky is very blue')
'Which pair is correct' reworded to 'Which form is correct'
Merhaba is stressed mer-HA-ba (an exception), not on the last syllable

corrections.at: l1 s2 panel[0] and many others
corrections.what: see options note below
Key 'keeps the word's identity' explained nothing; now says ğ lengthens the preceding vowel; why rewritten
Question was garbled (çiçeg); now asks why çiçek becomes çiçeği
'Turkish needs no a or the' corrected: no 'the', bir used for 'a'
'You are a teacher' was keyed to 'Sen benim öğretmenimsin' (you are MY teacher); now 'Sen bir öğretmensin.'
English aligned with Turkish (very beautiful; exactly three; 'I am from İzmir too' for 'Ben de')
Afiyet olsun is said to someone about to eat or eating, not after

corrections.at: l3 s1 explain, teach.model, panel[1] why
corrections.what: -ın applies to kış and yaz only; spring and autumn take -da
'when / zaman' was wrong (zaman = time); now 'time'
Negative -me pulls stress to the syllable BEFORE it (GEL-me-di), not onto -me; question, options and why rewritten
'Gülleri seviyorum' (the roses) changed to generic 'Ben gül severim'
'Otogar nerede acaba?' (acaba not in English) replaced by 'Affedersiniz, otogar nerede?'
Awkward questions reworded
Why named the wrong option as dismissive; now explains Saçma konuşuyorsun is the rude one
'Sayın Bay Yılmaz' -> 'Sayın Yılmaz'; 'Mrs Ayşe' -> 'Ms Ayşe'
izafet why made explicit
'Kurs ile ilgili' -> 'Kursla ilgili'
dialect/accent words: lehçe/aksent -> ağız/aksan (consistent with l6 s7)
Passive: -n after vowels (incelendi), -ın/-in after l, otherwise -ıl/-il/-ul/-ül
One-line why lengthened
Overstated claim about question intonation softened and made accurate
'to edit / düzeltmek' -> 'to correct'
Six cases stated as the usual description (instrumental sometimes added)
English now includes 'last night'
Old Anatolian Turkish dated 13th-15th century (was 11th-13th)
Yunus Emre was listed as an âşık minstrel; reframed as simple syllabic verse in the mystic/folk tradition
'Yardım edebilir misiniz' is ability, not conditional; English now includes thanks
Removed unverified claim about TSE term lists; English sentences aligned (laboratory, table)

corrections.at: all folders, gq and panel mc items
corrections.what: 164 items had wrong options rewritten (many were implausible or much shorter than the key); key-is-longest dropped from 61% to 5%; wrong options are now plausible learner errors
15 invented encyclopedia titles replaced by real English Wikipedia titles (wiki check: 0 missing)
